Live-verified in Play mode via UnityMCP: real ticked Update() progress ratios across 4 simultaneous foundations (1/2/3/4 builders, 60s solo buildTime) matched the formula to within float rounding (1 : 1.59999... : 1.89999... : 2.19999...). This makes rushing any building with extra workers meaningfully less efficient than before (was nx, now maxes out around 2.2x at 4 workers) - flagged in case it affects the relative value of any previously-tuned rush timing, though no specific matchup in the existing balance pass (item 5) depended on multi-builder speed.
